meta.title: 微风与星空的序曲 (Example BGM)

lines.text: 穿过玻璃窗的微风，吹醒沉睡的代码行
lines.translation: Breeze through the glass window wakes the sleeping lines of code

lines.text: 在夜色与星光之间，点亮一座赛博工坊
lines.translation: Between night and starlight, lighting up a cyber workshop

lines.text: 每一帧跳动的节拍，都记录着创造的魔法
lines.translation: Every beating frame records the magic of creation

lines.text: 把灵感写进剧本里，让故事随光影出发
lines.translation: Write inspiration into the script, let the story set off with light and shadow

lines.text: 愿每次驻足的目光，都能遇见温柔的回答
lines.translation: May every lingering gaze meet a gentle answer
